edges.reason: adjustPrice is externally callable and unrestricted, msg.sender influences which account triggers price changes
Price cooldown and timeSkipped depend on now, making adjustment timing miner-influenced
price.add(priceChange) and price.sub(priceChange) can overflow or underflow
lastUpdated is written from now at the end of the adjustment
loadDiff is derived from load, capacity and OPTIMAL_LOAD_PERCENTAGE
priceChange is built by chained mul/div and then subtracted from price
timeSkipped is computed as now.sub(lastUpdated) inside adjustPrice
adjustPrice invokes checkAllNodes before computing load and capacity
checkAllNodes refreshes totalNodes from getNumberOnlineNodes
complaint decisions use startComplaintBlockTimestamp and block.timestamp windows
complaint reads and mutates channel and complaint state
badNode is chosen from complaint and verification results before slashing
Complaint finalization performs external calls (NodeRotation, Punisher, KeyStorage) while channel state is not yet fully settled
slash is gated by the allow(SkaleDKG) modifier comparing msg.sender with the contract manager mapping
slash calls delegationController.confiscate externally
validatorId parameter is used to look up and slash the validator
forgive is protected only by onlyAdmin which resolves msg.sender to an admin role
amount parameter drives the forgiveness balance update
_locked[holder].sub(amount) can underflow if bookkeeping is inconsistent
confiscate derives currentMonth locally for value reduction
getBounty relies on isTimeForReward which compares lastRewardDate with block.timestamp
getBounty validates node ownership against msg.sender before paying
getBounty pays out via an external token send after state updates
_payBounty calls IERC777.send which invokes the recipient tokensReceived hook
withdrawBounty requires now >= launchTimestamp plus lockup months
withdrawBounty executes skaleToken.transfer to a caller supplied address
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas to an untrusted recipient before any external state check
space is subtracted from spaceOfNodes freeSpace, risking underflow
space is added to spaceOfNodes freeSpace, risking overflow
nodeIndex indexes the nodes and spaceOfNodes arrays
removeSpaceFromNode mutates the node space map after an unchecked subtraction
addSpaceToNode mutates the node space map after an unchecked addition
removeSchain decrements numberOfSchains and swaps array entries
lock adds amount to the holder locked balance without overflow guard beyond SafeMath
locked accumulates per-locker locked amounts for the wallet
getAndUpdateLockedAmount reads delegated partial-difference values
alright marks completion flags inside the channel dkgProcess
confiscate is restricted to allow(Punisher) based on msg.sender
_setSuccesfulDKG records now into lastSuccesfulDKG for the group

normalization_plan.reason: loadDiff is a function-local intermediate value only used inside adjustPrice
priceChange is computed and applied solely within adjustPrice
timeSkipped is a transient value derived from now and lastUpdated in adjustPrice
amount parameter flows directly into the forgive locked-balance update
validatorId parameter is consumed only by the slash confiscation flow
currentMonth is a local computation used only during confiscation
locked is a local accumulator inside the locked-amount computation
nodeIndex parameter addresses the node space map mutated by removeSpaceFromNode
badNode is a local selection used only to trigger slashing inside complaint
space parameter is the value added or removed in the node space map operations
